last_3_announcements.headline: 6-K: Q1 FY2026-27 unaudited consolidated financial results (IFRS) — earnings call details, revenue/EBITDA/profit highlights
6-K: FY2025-26 Annual Report furnished under India's Companies Act, 2013 (Ind AS financial statements) — distinct from the IFRS 20-F
Form 20-F: Annual and transition report of foreign private issuer for FY ended 2026-03-31 (IFRS financial statements, Major Shareholders table, risk factors) filed with SEC

consolidated_vs_standalone.note: Sify reports on TWO DIFFERENT accounting bases via two different filings that can show different numbers for the 'same' period: (1) Form 20-F to the SEC uses IFRS as issued by the IASB — this is the basis used for all P&L figures in this pack (revenue_ttm, net_profit_ttm, etc.); (2) a separate 6-K furnishes the statutory Companies Act, 2013 annual report using Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) — filed 2026-07-01, five days after the IFRS 20-F. Both are CONSOLIDATED (Sify has subsidiaries: Sify Data Centers, Sify Digital Services, etc.) — no standalone-only figures were surfaced in the documents reviewed. A pipeline that reads only one of these and represents it as 'the' financial statement is dropping a real dual-GAAP distinction.

traps: 1 ADS = 6 ordinary equity shares (₹10 face value each). Every per-share figure sourced from this pack (EPS, BVPS, dividend/share) is ADS-basis; dividing an INR-native net income/equity figure by ordinary-share count without applying the 6x ratio understates true per-ordinary-share value by 6x, and conversely any Indian-sourced per-share figure would be wrong if displayed as-is for the ADS.

Sify has NO BSE or NSE listing at all — equity shares are unlisted in India, only the ADS trades, on NASDAQ. A resolver that returns any BSE/NSE code, or invents an Indian promoter/FII/DII shareholding-pattern row, for this symbol is fabricating data (see shareholding.world_gap above); this is the manifest's designated hostile trait for this entity.

Market cap has no single authoritative value: manifest.json's own reference lists three conflicting 2026-02-13-era figures (Morningstar $989.09M, Hargreaves Lansdown $897.87M, an unsourced $789M) none of which match the live $1.012B computed here on 2026-09-22 — the spread is a mix of stale snapshots AND differing diluted-share assumptions, not a single 'wrong' source.

Sector/Industry classification disagrees between stockanalysis.com (Communication Services / Telecom Services) and Nasdaq.com itself (Technology / Computer Software: Programming, Data Processing) for the identical ticker on the identical day — a taxonomy trap, not a data-freshness trap.

Dual accounting basis: IFRS (20-F, SEC) vs Ind AS (6-K, Indian Companies Act) can legitimately show different consolidated P&L figures for the same fiscal year; collapsing them into one 'the financials' number is a definitional error, not a mismatch.
NASDAQ-CM (Capital Market) tier, not NASDAQ Global Select — a terminal that shows a blanket 'NASDAQ' badge without tier may overstate the listing standard this security actually meets.

Revenue/net-income TTM computed INR-natively from the company's own press releases (46,506M / -912M) implies a ~94.5 INR/USD conversion when checked against the aggregator's USD TTM figures (491.86M / -9.65M) — plausible for Sep 2026 but UNVERIFIED against a spot rate in this pack; do not treat the aggregator's USD TTM as a simple spot-rate translation of the INR figures without checking the FX assumption.
world_gaps: Indian-format quarterly shareholding pattern (promoter/FII/DII/public split with pledge %) does not exist for this security — see shareholding.world_gap. This is a genuine absence in the world, not a research failure.

ROCE (Return on Capital Employed) is not published by the aggregator checked (stockanalysis.com reports 'n/a'); ROIC (5.01%) and WACC (9.79%) are available as adjacent metrics but are not the same figure.
ROE is not published (net-loss TTM makes a standard positive-denominator ROE% non-standard to report); aggregator reports 'n/a' rather than a negative number.

No per-share/per-ADS EPS figure is disclosed inside the IFRS EX-99.1 press-release exhibits reviewed (Q1 FY27, Q4/FY26) — only aggregate INR profit/(loss) in millions; EPS had to be sourced from a third-party aggregator (stockanalysis.com) rather than the company's own primary filing text reviewed.

Exact calendar dates on which the 52-week high ($17.85) and low ($10.09) were SET are not disclosed by either Nasdaq.com or stockanalysis.com's summary views — only the trailing range value, not the date of the extremum.
Promoter share-pledge percentage: genuinely does not exist as a disclosure requirement for a NASDAQ-only ADR (Indian pledge-disclosure rules attach to BSE/NSE listing agreements).
